ev.q: From 2019 to 2021, the use of telemedicine technology increased for office-based physicians from 15.4% to 85.9%.
In 2021, 91.4% of primary care physicians, 87.2% of medical specialty physicians, and 74.8% of surgical specialty physicians used telemedicine technology.

notes: Cross-sectional design inferred from the named survey source. Survey weighting is not stated, so it is not recorded. Telemedicine use is health care use, so no condition is listed.
view_issues: Difference claims (higher among primary care and medical vs surgical specialties) are made with CIs shown as error bars, but no test or significance criterion is stated.
